About the company

A reliable partner in industrial flexible packaging.

Shandong Luxiang New Materials Co., Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer and supplier of FIBC bulk bags and geosynthetic products, headquartered in Jinan, Shandong Province. Founded in 2011, we serve global customers across agriculture, construction, mining, chemicals, environmental engineering and logistics.

Our operations are independently certified under ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, supported by an integrated production line, an in-house quality laboratory, and a dedicated export-oriented team.

  • ✓ Established 2011
  • ✓ Triple-ISO certified
  • ✓ AAA credit rating

  • ✓ Full traceability

Product categories
Product range

FIBC bulk bags & complete geosynthetic portfolio.

From single-trip food-grade FIBCs to engineered geomembranes — all built to international specifications and customizable to your drawings.

📦

FIBC / Bulk Bags

Our core product line — flexible bulk containers for industrial bulk solids, from 500 kg to 2,000 kg, customizable to your application.

  • Circular and U-panel bulk bags
  • Baffle (Q-bags) for stable cubic loads
  • Conductive (Type C) & dissipative (Type D)
  • Food-grade & pharma-grade options
  • UV-resistant, anti-static, flame-retardant variants
  • Up to 6-colour customer-logo printing
🛡️

Geosynthetic Products

Engineered geosynthetics for civil engineering, environmental and waterproofing applications.

  • Geotextiles (woven & non-woven)
  • HDPE geomembranes & composite geomembranes
  • Geogrids (PP, PE, fiberglass)
  • Waterproof boards & GCL waterproof blankets
  • Drainage / storage boards
  • Geotextile filter mesh & composite drainage networks

Why our FIBCs perform

Seven engineering principles built into every bag we ship.

1

High-strength materials

Woven PP or PET fabric — high tensile strength, tear resistance, multi-tonne capacity.

2

Moisture & dust proof

Specialized coatings and PE liners protect contents from humidity, dust and contamination.

3

Easy handling

Top lifting loops engineered for crane and forklift handling — fast, safe, low-labour.

4

Custom specifications

500–2,000 kg capacity. Dimensions, fabric weight and accessories built to your spec.

5

Recyclable & eco-friendly

Fully recyclable PP/PET — aligned with international sustainability standards.

6

Branded printing

Up to 6-colour customer-logo printing for clear brand identification on every bag.

7

Optional features

UV stabilization, flame retardancy, Type C / Type D — for hazardous-area use.

Production process

Seven controlled stages, end-to-end traceability.

Every bag is manufactured under a strictly controlled, ISO 9001 process — from incoming raw material to final shipment.

Raw Material Preparation

PP / PET resin and additives inspected on arrival: melt index, tensile strength, elongation. Supplier & batch records kept for full traceability.

1
2

Compounding & Extrusion

Resin blended with masterbatch, slip and anti-aging agents — extruded into film at 200–260 °C with controlled thickness.

Film Blowing & Weaving

Tubular film blown and woven into fabric. Air-ring cooling for smooth, bubble-free finish. Thickness held between 0.03–0.08 mm.

3
4

Printing

Customer logos, identification marks and safety pictograms printed in up to 6 colours — 100% inspected for clarity and registration.

Cutting & Bag Making

Woven fabric cut to spec by high-precision automated cutters. Film heat-sealed for perfect liner integrity.

5
6

Sewing & Assembly

Industrial sewing machines with controlled tension, pitch and density. Critical zones (mouth, lifting loops, base) double-reinforced.

Inspection & Packing

Dimensional, visual, seam-strength, air-tightness and stacking tests. Only conforming bags released to packing and shipment.

7
Quality assurance

Eight layers of quality, from raw material to delivery.

Our quality system is embedded across the entire value chain — every stage controlled, monitored and documented.

A

Raw Material Procurement

Approved-supplier list, signed quality agreements, incoming inspection & batch sampling. FIFO controlled storage.

B

In-Process Control

High-precision cutting, automated sewing with controlled tension & pitch, random tensile/air-tightness sampling.

C

Equipment & Process

Scheduled maintenance, calibration of extruders, looms, printers, cutters & sewing machines. Real-time parameter monitoring.

D

Finished-Product Inspection

100% visual inspection. Sample testing for tensile strength, tear strength and pressure resistance.

E

Traceability & Improvement

Raw-material origin, key parameters and inspection results recorded per batch. Issues traced to root cause within hours.

F

Customer Feedback & After-Sales

Structured feedback channels, repair or replacement within warranty, regular customer revisits.

G

Quality Management System

ISO 9001 certified. Export products produced to meet international requirements (CE, FDA on request).

H

People & Quality Culture

Regular quality-awareness and skills training. Quality-incentive mechanism rewards continuous improvement.

Engineered to GB/T 10454 & international standards

Our FIBCs are designed and tested to the requirements of the Chinese national standard GB/T 10454 — Flexible Freight Container, covering dimensional tolerances, fabric and lifting-loop tensile strength, sewing requirements, and full-bag performance tests (cyclic lifting, vertical drop, compression, topple, righting, and tear-propagation). Equivalent international standards including ISO 21898 available on request.
